mc_spatial_audio.config.title: MC Spatial Audio
mc_spatial_audio.config.enabled.tooltip: Route Minecraft audio through Apple's headphone spatial renderer. Apply reloads audio safely. Uses the macOS default output device.
mc_spatial_audio.config.tracking.tooltip: Request Apple-managed head tracking on supported headphones. Off keeps fixed spatialization. Apple controls the reference frame; the mod does not add a recenter timer.
mc_spatial_audio.config.apple: Apple manages head tracking and its reference frame. Select your headphones in macOS before applying.
mc_spatial_audio.config.macos: The native audio backend requires macOS. Other platforms keep ordinary Minecraft audio.
mc_spatial_audio.config.override: The enabled setting is controlled by the mcspatial.enabled JVM argument. Remove that argument to change it here.
mc_spatial_audio.config.staged: Defaults staged. Apply to save them.
mc_spatial_audio.config.failed: Could not apply settings. Check latest.log.
